title: Rafael and the Veil
author: Marguerite Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Coldharbour, a thief who steals memories, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
